manuals.title: Main Menu
manuals.summary: Central entry point of DayPass: install or update packages first, then open the network, proxy, hardware and maintenance menus.
manuals.reachable_from: Runs at the end of the installer / DayPass start

manuals.title: Network Settings
manuals.summary: Manages the home Wi-Fi access point, the isolated guest network, the router LAN IP, multi-WAN balancing, live speed monitoring and DNS mode.

manuals.title: Wi-Fi Access Point (Home WiFi)
manuals.summary: Manages only the Access Point interfaces of the home Wi-Fi on every radio; station/WWAN interfaces are never modified.

manuals.title: Guest Network & Bandwidth Control
manuals.summary: Builds an isolated guest LAN on 192.168.200.0/24 with its own DHCP server, firewall zone and optional guest Wi-Fi.

manuals.title: Guest Bandwidth Control (QoS)
manuals.summary: Caps guest download and upload speed with either lightweight tc rules or SQM using the Cake algorithm.

manuals.title: DNS Manager
manuals.summary: Controls how the router resolves names for the local network. The status header shows the active mode, the detected Passwall package and the current dnsmasq upstreams. The chosen mode is remembered under /etc/daypass/dns/mode.

manuals.title: DNS Resolution Recovery
manuals.summary: Temporary DNS switch that is offered by the network checker when domain resolution fails. It changes DNS only for the current session and is not a replacement for the permanent DNS Manager.
manuals.reachable_from: Offered by the network checker when DNS resolution fails

manuals.title: Multi-WAN Load Balancer
manuals.summary: Adds USB tethering and Wi-Fi hotspot as extra internet sources and balances all links with mwan3 policies (balanced + failover).

manuals.title: Network Info & Speed Monitor
manuals.summary: Diagnostic panel that reports public IP details and can show live WAN bandwidth. The panel also reports offline state when no provider can be reached.

manuals.title: Proxy & Routing Manager
manuals.summary: All Passwall-related tools in one place: local node and subscription storage, traffic routing, balancing, health checks, routing profiles and Cloudflare Clean IP.

manuals.title: Config Manager (Nodes & Subscriptions)
manuals.summary: Local node store for single share links and subscription links. Configs live in /etc/daypass/proxy/configs and the header shows the detected Passwall engine.

manuals.title: Traffic Routing / Shunt Rules
manuals.summary: Switches Passwall between ready-made traffic routing modes and records the active mode locally so the menu can show it later.

manuals.title: Node Load Balancing
manuals.summary: Chooses which saved nodes take part in balancing and writes the balancer settings into Passwall. The status header shows the active mode and node count.

manuals.title: Load Balancing Modes
manuals.summary: The mode list shown by Set Balancing Mode. The choice is stored locally and used the next time you apply the balancer.

manuals.title: Node Health Checker
manuals.summary: Tests whether saved nodes are reachable by opening a TCP connection to the host and port inside each share link, and reports approximate latency in milliseconds.

manuals.title: Routing Profiles
manuals.summary: Ready-made traffic profiles that apply a routing mode to Passwall and remember the active profile. The header shows the active profile and the current routing mode.

manuals.title: Clean IP Manager (Cloudflare)
manuals.summary: Scans candidate Cloudflare IPs on a config's own port, then replaces only the address inside the share link. SNI, Host and Path stay untouched. The header shows the detected proxy core.

manuals.title: Clean IP Test Mode
manuals.summary: Test depth that Find Clean IP for a Config asks for before scanning the candidate IP list.

manuals.title: Maintenance & Recovery
manuals.summary: Repair and clean-up tools for the system module. The same module also powers the read-only Hardware & Resource Status screen (main menu option 5), which shows architecture, OpenWrt release, RAM and storage usage.

manuals.title: Service Manager
manuals.summary: Post-deployment service orchestration for the core network stack. It runs automatically after a deployment and has no interactive menu, so the entries below describe the services it controls rather than menu numbers.
